name: Google Maps leads (phone, website, rating) to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Google Maps leads to Google Sheets
Search Google Maps like a customer would (keyword + city) and drop every business into a sheet: name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count. Re-runs update existing rows, so the sheet stays one row per place.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Credentials > New > *Header Auth*. Name it `Apify API token`. Header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > Integrations).
2. Open the Google Sheets node(s), connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` (and the tab name if needed).
3. Edit `searchStringsArray` and `locationQuery` in *Run Apify actor* (more options: the actor page).
4. Click *Execute workflow* to test with the small sample input, then activate.

Runs the Apify actor https://apify.com/transparent_meteorite/google-maps-places-scraper (pay-per-result; the free Apify plan credit covers a trial). Maintained by the author of the actor.
